item.title: Apache Shenyu
item.author: emecas
item.description:
Apache Shenyu
Java native API Gateway for service proxy, protocol conversion and API governance.
https://shenyu.apache.org/

https://github.com/apache/shenyu

Feature List

- Language: provides .NET, Python, Go, Java client for API register
- Proxy: Support for Apache® Dubbo™, Spring Cloud, gRPC, Motan, SOFA, TARS, WebSocket, MQTT
- Security: Sign, OAuth 2.0, JSON Web Tokens, WAF plugin
- API governance: Request, response, parameter mapping, Hystrix, RateLimiter plugin
- Observability: Tracing, metrics, logging plugin
- Extensions: Plugin hot-swapping, dynamic loading
- Dashboard: Dynamic traffic control, visual backend for user menu permissions
- Cluster: NGINX, Docker, Kubernetes

item.title: Redoc
item.author: emecas
item.description:
Redoc
Generate beautiful API documentation from OpenAPI

Redoc is an open source tool for generating documentation from OpenAPI (formerly Swagger) definitions.

By default Redoc offers a three-panel, responsive layout:

The left panel contains a search bar and navigation menu.
The central panel contains the documentation.
The right panel contains request and response examples.

Redoc Live demo
If you want to see how Redoc renders your OpenAPI definition, you can try it out online at https://redocly.github.io/redoc/.

item.title: InboxSDK
item.author: emecas
item.description:
InboxSDK
Repo: https://github.com/inboxSDK/inboxsdk
Documentation: https://inboxsdk.github.io/inboxsdk-docs/
Doc repo: https://github.com/InboxSDK/inboxsdk-docs
The InboxSDK lets you build apps for Gmail.

InboxSDK is a JavaScript library for building apps inside Gmail with browser extensions. It features a high-level declarative API that handles all DOM manipulation in a performant way. InboxSDK can handle multiple inboxes, conversation mode, fullscreen compose, popouts, and themes.

Getting Started
https://inboxsdk.github.io/inboxsdk-docs/#quick-start

Source: commit 93c90fa in My-Notes.
